Cross-tile dependence passes through shared read request arbitration, request source metadata, response destination decode and response valid arbitration. It does not describe a tile0 data token being delivered to tile8.
Read and response crossbars use bypass input queues. DataMemWrapper is configured combinational, so this request-to-response metadata/control path contains no mandatory register edge.
The stock ABC path ends at tile8 reg_bank0, whereas this nearly tied independent NLDM path ends at reg_bank3; do not label this file as the exact ABC endpoint-bit path.
